description: This file contains the LocationDao class which manages database interactions related to location entities, including retrieval, search, creation, and deletion of location records within an HR management system.

classes.name: LocationDao
classes.description: Data access object class for performing CRUD and search operations on Location entities within the database.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Retrieves a Location entity by its ID, returning null if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getExistingLocationIds
methods.description: Fetches existing location IDs from the database that match the provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Location records matching specified search filters.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for Location entities based on provided search filters and returns the matching list.

methods.name: searchLocationsPaginator
methods.description: Builds and configures the query with pagination and sorting to retrieve filtered Location data.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Returns the number of employees assigned to a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationsIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all location IDs ordered by name.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Gets location IDs for employees identified by their employee numbers.

methods.name: getLocationsByIds
methods.description: Fetches Location entities corresponding to a list of location IDs.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Persists a Location entity into the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Deletes locations from the database based on a list of location IDs.
